title: Child on Toy Fire Truck Ride, 1948 Bradley Beach B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A candid post-WWII summer snapshot capturing a young child steering a miniature fire truck on a kiddie ride along the boardwalk in Bradley Beach, New Jersey, in 1948. The child wears summer overalls while grasping the steering wheel with a metal bell mounted on the front. Victorian-style seaside buildings and another child riding behind are visible in the background, reflecting mid-century American coastal leisure culture.
